name: Te Pusi mo te Ali
description: A foundational nature legend in Tuvaluan folklore depicting the primordial competition and relationship between the eel (pusi) and the flounder (ali), explaining coastal characteristics and tidal movements.
appearance: Represented in oral storytelling as a sleek, powerful eel and a flat, wise flounder inhabiting the shallow coral lagoons of Tuvalu.
behavior: Navigates the coral reefs and lagoons, engaging in traditional cosmological interactions that shape the island geography.
habitat: Coral reefs and lagoons of Tuvalu
cultural_significance: Nature-spirit legend from Tuvalu explaining the ecological balance of reef marine life and lagoon geography.
summary: The legendary eel and flounder duo of Tuvaluan folklore shaping reef geography and marine life.
fun_fact: Tuvaluan oral narratives use the story of the eel and flounder to teach respect for reef ecosystems.

seo_description: Explore Te Pusi mo te Ali, the legendary eel and flounder spirits of Tuvaluan coral reefs.
